candidates.label: Perfected-detailed Book: Quran described as uhkimat ayatuhu thumma fussilat from Hakeem Khabeer establishing dual quality of precision and elaboration
candidates.definition: In 11:1: Alif Lam Ra. A Book whose verses are perfected then detailed from One Wise Acquainted.

evidence.excerpt: الٓرۚ كِتَٰبٌ أُحۡكِمَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتۡ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
evidence.rationale: Kitabun ohkimat ayatuhu thumma fussilat: two-stage description establishing both structural perfection and communicative detail. Min ladun hakeemin khabeerin: divine source attributing both wisdom and intimate knowledge.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Dual descriptor pairing (uhkimat+fussilat) resolves tension between Quran's concise legal precision and its narrative elaboration. Hakeem-Khabeer pairing grounds textual qualities in divine attributes.

candidates.label: Istighfar-provision linkage: seeking forgiveness and repentance yields good temporal provision and favor distribution connecting spiritual practice to material well-being
candidates.definition: In 11:3: Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him. He will let you enjoy good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يُمَتِّعۡكُم مَّتَٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى وَيُؤۡتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضۡلٖ فَضۡلَهُۥۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٖ كَبِيرٍ
evidence.rationale: Istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi: sequential istighfar-tawbah as condition. YumattiAAkum mataAAan hasanan: temporal enjoyment as consequence. Ila ajalin musamman: time-bound nature preventing materialist reading. Wayuti kulla thee fadlin fadlahu: individualized favor distribution.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes causal link between spiritual rectification and material provision without reducing faith to transaction. Ajal musamman qualifier prevents prosperity-gospel reading.

candidates.label: Human psychological volatility: mercy withdrawal produces despair-ingratitude while favor after hardship produces boastful exultation revealing fortune-dependent faith instability
candidates.definition: In 11:9-10: If We give man mercy then withdraw it he is despairing ungrateful. If We give favor after hardship he says bad times left me indeed he is exultant boastful.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةٗ ثُمَّ نَزَعۡنَٰهَا مِنۡهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٞ كَفُورٞ
evidence.rationale: Layaoosun kafoorun: despair paired with ingratitude showing emotional collapse triggers theological failure.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَٰهُ نَعۡمَآءَ بَعۡدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتُ عَنِّيٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَفَرِحٞ فَخُورٌ
evidence.rationale: Lafarihun fakhoorun: exultation paired with boastfulness showing comfort triggers self-attribution error.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Psychological analysis reveals symmetric vulnerability: both deprivation and prosperity threaten faith integrity. Contrasts with sabr-amal salih stability in 11:11.

candidates.label: Ten-surah challenge: falsification criterion demanding production of ten invented surahs calling upon anyone besides Allah proving Quran's divine origin through non-response
candidates.definition: In 11:13-14: Say bring ten surahs like it invented and call whomever you can besides Allah if truthful. If they do not respond know it was revealed with Allah's knowledge.

evidence.excerpt: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِعَشۡرِ سُوَرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ مُفۡتَرَيَٰتٖ وَٱدۡعُواْ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Faatoo biAAashri suwarin mithlihi muftarayatin: specific quantitative challenge with invention-permission lowering barrier. WaodAAoo mani istataAAtum min dooni Allahi: open assistance invitation maximizing opponent resources.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِلَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ بِعِلۡمِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Fai llam yastajeeboo lakum faiAAlamoo annama onzila biAAilmi Allahi: non-response as positive proof of divine origin. Fahal antum muslimoona: rhetorical conversion appeal following evidentiary demonstration.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Most specific quantitative challenge in Quran (ten surahs vs one or whole). Muftarayatin concession removes originality objection. Non-response logic transforms absence into evidence.

candidates.label: Worldly-desire seekers fully repaid here: those wanting dunya life and adornment receive complete compensation without deprivation but Fire alone in Hereafter with worthless deeds
candidates.definition: In 11:15-16: Whoever desires worldly life We fully repay their deeds therein not deprived. Those have only Fire in Hereafter; lost what they made worthless what they did.

evidence.excerpt: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فِيهَا وَهُمۡ فِيهَا لَا يُبۡخَسُونَ
evidence.rationale: Nuwaffi ilayhim aAAmalahum feeha: complete compensation principle. Wala yubkhasoona: no injustice even to worldly-oriented.

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيۡسَ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُواْ فِيهَا وَبَٰطِلٞ مَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Laysa lahum fee alakhirati illa alnnaru: exclusive Fire outcome. Wahabita ma sanaAAoo: deed-nullification. Wabatilun ma kanoo yaAAmaloona: retroactive worthlessness.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes divine justice even for disbelievers in temporal realm. Complete worldly repayment prevents grievance. Deed-nullification shows actions require correct intention-framework to have eternal value.

candidates.label: Clear-evidence believer with divine witness: person on bayyinah from Lord with shahid minhu and Musa's Book as imam-mercy believes in Quran establishing multi-source verification
candidates.definition: In 11:17: Is one on clear evidence from Lord followed by witness from Him and before it Musa's Book as leader and mercy? Those believe in it.

evidence.excerpt: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتۡلُوهُ شَاهِدٞ مِّنۡهُ وَمِن قَبۡلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامٗا وَرَحۡمَةًۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوۡعِدُهُۥۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: AAala bayyinatin min rabbihi: primary divine evidence. Wayatloohu shahidun minhu: corroborating divine witness. Kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan: prior scripture confirmation. Olaika yuminoona bihi: belief as natural outcome of multi-source verification.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Triple-evidence structure (bayyinah + shahid + prior scripture) models epistemological robustness. Imam-rahmah pairing shows guidance and mercy as complementary scripture functions.

candidates.label: Supreme injustice of fabricating lies against Allah: inventing falsehood about God as worst wrongdoing with public exposure before Lord and witness testimony confirming lying
candidates.definition: In 11:18: Who is more unjust than one who invents lie about Allah? Those presented before Lord witnesses say these lied against Lord. Curse of Allah on wrongdoers.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡأَشۡهَٰدُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡۚ أَلَا لَعۡنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban: superlative injustice framing. YuAAradoona AAala rabbihim: public presentation. Wayaqoolu alashhadu haolai allatheena kathaboo: witness confirmation. Ala laAAnatu Allahi: divine curse as consequence.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes theological crime hierarchy with fabrication-at-top. Public-exposure scene serves as deterrent. Witness testimony parallels earthly legal procedure.

candidates.label: Two-party parable: blind-deaf versus seeing-hearing as fundamental epistemological divide illustrating irreducible inequality between disbelief and faith
candidates.definition: In 11:24: Example of two parties like blind-deaf and seeing-hearing. Are they equal? Will you not remember?

evidence.excerpt: ۞مَثَلُ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ كَٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡأَصَمِّ وَٱلۡبَصِيرِ وَٱلسَّمِيعِۚ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Mathalu alfareeqayni kaalaAAma waalasammi waalbaseeri waalssameeAAi: sensory metaphor mapping spiritual states. Hal yastawiyani mathalan: rhetorical equality-negation. Afala tathakkaroona: memory-appeal closing argument.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Sensory-metaphor makes abstract epistemological distinction concrete. Binary structure eliminates middle ground. Positioned as section-summary after detailed contrast of believer-disbeliever outcomes.

candidates.label: Universal creature provision doctrine: every dabbah on earth has rizq guaranteed by Allah who knows mustaqarr and mustawda' all recorded in kitab mubeen
candidates.definition: In 11:6: No creature on earth but upon Allah is its provision. He knows its dwelling and storage. All in clear register.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَيَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاۚ كُلّٞ فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ
evidence.rationale: Wama min dabbatin fee alardi illa AAala Allahi rizquha: universal scope encompassing all creatures. WayaAAlamu mustaqarraha wamustawdaAAaha: comprehensive spatial-temporal knowledge. Kullun fee kitabin mubeenin: written-record guarantee.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Extends divine care beyond humans establishing ecological theology. Mustaqarr-mustawda' pairing covers both fixed and transient states. Kitab mubeen provides metaphysical guarantee beyond observable provision.

candidates.label: Creation as test of best conduct: six-day creation with Throne on water explicitly purposed to test which person is best in deed establishing existence as examination
candidates.definition: In 11:7: He created heavens earth in six days His Throne on water to test you which is best in deed.

evidence.excerpt: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَكَانَ عَرۡشُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۗ وَلَئِن قُلۡتَ إِنَّكُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
evidence.rationale: Liyaabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan: explicit test-purpose clause. Ahsanu (best) not aktharu (most) emphasizing quality over quantity. Throne-on-water detail grounds cosmology in divine sovereignty.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Test-purpose framing gives existential meaning to creation. Quality-emphasis (ahsanu) prevents mechanical deed-counting. Six-day + Throne context situates human test within cosmic framework.

candidates.label: Elite social-status rejection: dismissing prophet as mere man followed by lowest social class (arathiluna badiya al-rrayi) revealing class-based epistemological barrier
candidates.definition: In 11:27: Eminent disbelievers said we see you only as man like us followed only by lowest among us at first suggestion. We see no merit in you; we think you liars.

evidence.excerpt: فَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ مَا نَرَىٰكَ إِلَّا بَشَرٗا مِّثۡلَنَا وَمَا نَرَىٰكَ ٱتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ ٱلرَّأۡيِ وَمَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا مِن فَضۡلِۭ بَلۡ نَظُنُّكُمۡ كَٰذِبِينَ
evidence.rationale: Ma naraka illa basharan mithlana: humanity-as-limitation argument. Illa allatheena hum arathiluna badiya alrrayi: follower-quality dismissal. Badiya al-rrayi suggests impulsive unthinking adherence. Ma nara lakum AAalayna min fadlin: merit-denial based on social hierarchy.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Reveals how social status functions as epistemological filter. Arathiluna (lowest) + badiya al-rrayi (first opinion) double-dismissal targets both class and intellectual quality. Pattern recurs across all prophet narratives.

candidates.label: Prophetic disavowal template: Nuh denies possessing treasuries unseen-knowledge or angelhood affirming pure messenger function limited to conveyed revelation
candidates.definition: In 11:31: I do not say I have Allah's treasuries or know unseen or am angel. Allah knows best what is in their souls.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ عِندِي خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِنِّي مَلَكٞ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزۡدَرِيٓ أَعۡيُنُكُمۡ لَن يُؤۡتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ خَيۡرًاۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wala aqoolu lakum AAindee khazainu Allahi: material-resource denial. Wala aAAlamu alghayba: supernatural-knowledge denial. Wala aqoolu innee malakun: ontological-status denial. Allahu aAAlamu bima fee anfusihim: divine-knowledge deference.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Three-fold denial systematically strips prophet of any independent authority. Positions messenger as pure conduit. Prevents personality-cult formation around prophetic figure.

candidates.label: Believer protection principle: refusing to expel low-status believers because they will meet their Lord establishing divine accountability as social-equality guarantor
candidates.definition: In 11:29-30: I am not driving away believers; they will meet their Lord. Who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away?

evidence.excerpt: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ لَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مَالًاۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْۚ إِنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَٰكِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُمۡ قَوۡمٗا تَجۡهَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wama ana bitaridi allatheena amanoo: expulsion-refusal. Innahum mulaqoo rabbihim: divine-meeting as dignity-grounding.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Man yansurunee mina Allahi in taradtuhum: rhetorical protection-question making expulsion existentially dangerous for prophet himself.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes faith-based social equality overriding class hierarchy. Divine-meeting (mulaqoo rabbihim) grants believers irreducible dignity. Protection-question makes social justice a matter of prophetic self-preservation.

candidates.label: Ship construction under divine observation: building bi-a'yunina wawahyina establishing continuous supervision and inspiration during obedient labor amid ridicule
candidates.definition: In 11:37: Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration. Do not address Me concerning wrongdoers; they are drowned.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا وَلَا تُخَٰطِبۡنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغۡرَقُونَ
evidence.rationale: WaisnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina: dual divine-presence (observation+inspiration) during construction. Wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo: intercession-prohibition. Innahum mughraqoona: predetermined fate stated as fact.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Bi-a'yunina wawahyina pairing sanctifies physical labor. Intercession-prohibition establishes boundary between prophetic compassion and divine decree. Mughraqoona certainty contrasts with ongoing construction uncertainty.

candidates.label: Father-son separation by faith: Nuh's son refuses boarding seeking mountain refuge; waves separate them; divine correction redefines family by righteousness not blood
candidates.definition: In 11:42-46: Son says I will take refuge on mountain. Nuh says no protector today except mercy. Waves separated them. Nuh appeals son is family. Allah says not of family; unrighteous work; do not ask without knowledge.

evidence.excerpt: وَهِيَ تَجۡرِي بِهِمۡ فِي مَوۡجٖ كَٱلۡجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبۡنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِي مَعۡزِلٖ يَٰبُنَيَّ ٱرۡكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Ya bunayya irkab maAAana: paternal plea. Wala takun maAAa alkafireena: faith-binary framing.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِيٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٖ يَعۡصِمُنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَۚ وَحَالَ بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡمَوۡجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُغۡرَقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Saawee ila jabalin: son's alternative-trust. La AAasima alyawma min amri Allahi illa man rahima: absolute divine-decree supremacy.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ يَٰنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيۡسَ مِنۡ أَهۡلِكَۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيۡرُ صَٰلِحٖۖ فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٌۖ إِنِّيٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
evidence.rationale: Innahu laysa min ahlika: family-membership revoked. Innahu AAamalun ghayru salihin: righteousness substituted for lineage. Fala tasalni ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun: knowledge-boundary enforcement.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Most emotionally intense prophet-narrative moment. Amal ghayr salih redefinition of family collapses biological privilege. Knowledge-boundary (11:46-47) prevents prophetic intercession from overriding divine criteria.

candidates.label: Disembarkation blessing with future warning: salam-barakat upon Nuh and nations from those with him; other nations enjoy then face painful punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:48: Disembark in peace from Us and blessings upon you and nations from those with you. Other nations We grant enjoyment then painful punishment touches them.

evidence.excerpt: قِيلَ يَٰنُوحُ ٱهۡبِطۡ بِسَلَٰمٖ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَٰتٍ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ أُمَمٖ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَۚ وَأُمَمٞ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Ihbit bisalamin minna wabarakatin: dual divine-gift (peace+blessings). WaAAala omamin mimman maAAaka: blessing extends to descendant nations. Waomamun sanumattiAAuhum thumma yamassuhum minna AAathabun aleemun: cyclical rise-fall pattern for future communities.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes post-deluge covenant framework. Blessing-punishment duality for future nations previews entire subsequent prophetic history. SanumattiAAuhum (We grant enjoyment) shows divine agency in temporal prosperity.

candidates.label: Hud's istighfar-rain-strength promise: seek forgiveness repent yields rain showers and added strength linking spiritual renewal to environmental and physical empowerment
candidates.definition: In 11:52: O my people seek forgiveness of your Lord then repent. He will send sky rain in showers and increase you strength added to your strength.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا وَيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمۡ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi: identical formula to 11:3. Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran: abundant rain as tangible response. Wayazidkum quwwatan ila quwwatikum: strength-addition implying existing capacity enhanced not replaced.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Parallels 11:3 istighfar-provision theme but specifies environmental mechanism (rain). Quwwatan ila quwwatikum suggests cumulative empowerment. Contextualizes Ad's physical might as potentially renewable through repentance.

candidates.label: Tawakkul with forelock-holding imagery: Hud declares reliance on Allah who holds every creature's forelock establishing total divine control metaphor
candidates.definition: In 11:56: I have relied upon Allah my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but He holds its forelock. My Lord is on straight path.

evidence.excerpt: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذُۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Innee tawakkaltu AAala Allahi: personal trust declaration. Rabbee warabbikum: shared lordship eliminating hierarchy. Ma min dabbatin illa huwa akhithun binasiyatiha: universal control via forelock-metaphor. Inna rabbee AAala siratin mustaqeemin: divine-path certainty grounding trust.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Naseeyah (forelock) metaphor conveys total control without violence imagery. Shared-lordship (rabbee warabbikum) democratizes divine relationship. Sirat mustaqeem attribution to Allah Himself (not just human path) grounds cosmic order.

candidates.label: Ad's obstinate tyranny pattern: rejected signs disobeyed messengers followed every jabbar aneed establishing leadership-following as destruction mechanism
candidates.definition: In 11:59: That was Ad who rejected Lord's signs disobeyed His messengers followed command of every obstinate tyrant.

evidence.excerpt: وَتِلۡكَ عَادٞۖ جَحَدُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَصَوۡاْ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ
evidence.rationale: Jahadoo biayati rabbihim: sign-rejection. WaAAasaw rusulahu: messenger-disobedience. WaittabaAAoo amra kulli jabbarin AAaneedin: systematic tyrant-following. Kulli (every) indicates pattern not isolated incident.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Three-step degradation: reject evidence → disobey messenger → follow tyrant. Jabbar-Aneed pairing combines power-abuse with stubbornness. Kulli generalizes to systemic political pathology.

candidates.label: Double-world curse: Ad followed by curse in this world and Resurrection Day establishing comprehensive consequences extending beyond temporal punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:60: They were followed in this world with curse and on Resurrection Day. Indeed Ad denied their Lord; away with Ad people of Hud.

evidence.excerpt: وَأُتۡبِعُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةٗ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادٗا كَفَرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡۗ أَلَا بُعۡدٗا لِّعَادٖ قَوۡمِ هُودٖ
evidence.rationale: WaotbiAAoo fee hathihi alddunya laAAnatan wayawma alqiyamati: dual-temporal curse. Ala inna AAadan kafaroo rabbahum: denial-diagnosis. Ala buAAdan liAAadin qawmi hoodin: distancing-formula as final verdict.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Dual-curse structure shows consequences transcend temporal destruction. Kafaroo rabbahum (denied their Lord) uses possessive emphasizing broken relationship. BuAAdan formula echoes throughout surah marking each nation's closure.

candidates.label: She-camel as divine sign with harm prohibition: naqat Allah designated as ayah with feeding permission and touching-harm prohibition triggering timed punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:64-65: This she-camel of Allah is sign for you. Let her feed on Allah's earth. Do not touch with harm or impending punishment takes you. They hamstrung her.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمۡ ءَايَةٗۖ فَذَرُوهَا تَأۡكُلۡ فِيٓ أَرۡضِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٞ قَرِيبٞ
evidence.rationale: Hathihi naqatu Allahi lakum ayatan: divine-ownership designation. Fatharooha takul fee ardi Allahi: feeding-permission on divine-earth. Wala tamassooha bisooin: harm-prohibition. Fayakhuthakum AAathabun qareebun: imminent-punishment warning.

evidence.excerpt: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُواْ فِي دَارِكُمۡ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٖۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعۡدٌ غَيۡرُ مَكۡذُوبٖ
evidence.rationale: FaAAaqarooha: deliberate hamstringing as sign-violation. TamattaAAoo fee darikum thalathata ayyamin: precise three-day grace period. Thalika waAAdun ghayru makthoobin: unfailing-promise emphasis.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Only prophet-narrative with animal-sign bearing explicit harm-prohibition. Three-day window creates suspense-testing interval. Ghayru makthoobin emphasizes divine-promise reliability even for punishment.

candidates.label: Sayhah destruction pattern: shriek seizes wrongdoers leaving them prone in homes as if never prospered establishing sudden-total annihilation signature
candidates.definition: In 11:67-68: Shriek seized wrongdoers; they became prone in homes. As if never prospered. Thamud denied Lord; away with Thamud.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ فِي دِيَٰرِهِمۡ جَٰثِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Waakhatha allatheena thalamoo alssayhatu: sayhah as divine-instrument. Faasbahoo fee diyarihim jathimeena: domestic-setting death emphasizing totality.

evidence.excerpt: كَأَن لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡاْ فِيهَآۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَاْ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡۗ أَلَا بُعۡدٗا لِّثَمُودَ
evidence.rationale: Kaan lam yaghnaw feeha: prosperity-erasure metaphor. Ala inna thamooda kafaroo rabbahum: denial-diagnosis. Ala buAAdan lithamooda: closure-formula.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Jathimeena (prone/fallen) conveys instantaneity. Kaan lam yaghnaw erases historical presence. Identical formula repeated for Madyan (11:94-95) establishing pattern-recognition device.

candidates.label: Ibrahim's hospitality model: immediate salam exchange roasted calf offering establishing prophetic hospitality standard with guest honor priority
candidates.definition: In 11:69: Messengers came to Ibrahim with glad tidings. They said peace. He said peace. Did not delay bringing roasted calf.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ حَنِيذٖ
evidence.rationale: Qaloo salaman qala salamun: reciprocal peace-exchange. Fama labitha an jaa biAAijlin haneethin: speed-emphasis (fama labitha) showing hospitality urgency. AAijlin haneethin: specific food-quality detail.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Hospitality sequence (greeting→food) establishes prophetic etiquette norm. Speed-emphasis shows eagerness. Haneethin (roasted/fattened) indicates best-available offering.

candidates.label: Sarah's amazed laughter at old-age birth: human limitation confronted by divine creative power producing astonished joy mixed with incredulity
candidates.definition: In 11:71-72: Wife standing smiled. Given glad tidings of Ishaq and Yaqub. She said woe to me shall I bear when old and husband old? Amazing thing!

evidence.excerpt: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٞ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهَا بِإِسۡحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسۡحَٰقَ يَعۡقُوبَ
evidence.rationale: Waimraatuhu qaimatun fadahikat: standing-smile suggesting attentive reception. Fabashsharnaha biishaqa wamin warai ishaqa yaAAqooba: double-generation promise.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَتۡ يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٞ وَهَٰذَا بَعۡلِي شَيۡخًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٞ
evidence.rationale: Ya waylata aalidu waana AAajoozun: self-referential impossibility assessment. Wahatha baAAlee shaykhan: spouse-age compounding factor. Inna hatha lashayon AAajeebun: amazement-declaration.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Human emotional authenticity preserved within miracle narrative. Double-generation promise (Ishaq+Yaqub) exceeds request. AAajeebun acknowledges genuine wonder without disbelief.

candidates.label: Intercession boundary: Ibrahim's pleading for Lot halted by angels declaring Lord's command arrived punishment irrevocable establishing prophetic-intercession limits
candidates.definition: In 11:74-76: After fright left and glad tidings came he argued concerning Lot. Angels said give up; Lord's command come; punishment cannot be repelled.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنۡ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوۡعُ وَجَآءَتۡهُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ يُجَٰدِلُنَا فِي قَوۡمِ لُوطٍ
evidence.rationale: Yujadiluna fee qawmi lootin: active argumentation showing prophetic compassion.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ أَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ هَٰذَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ قَدۡ جَآءَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۖ وَإِنَّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِمۡ عَذَابٌ غَيۡرُ مَرۡدُودٖ
evidence.rationale: AaArid AAan hatha: cessation-command. Innahu qad jaa amru rabbika: decree-finality. AAathabun ghayru mardoodin: irrevocability emphasis.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes intercession has boundaries set by divine decree timing. Ghayru mardoodin prevents any hope of reversal once threshold crossed. Compassionate-argument preserved as virtuous even when unsuccessful.

candidates.label: Lot's protective anguish for guests: host distress at community intentions offering daughters as purer alternative revealing extreme hospitality obligation
candidates.definition: In 11:77-79: Lot anguished felt discomfort said trying day. People hastening doing evil. He said these my daughters purer for you fear Allah do not disgrace me in guests.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوطٗا سِيٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعٗا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَصِيبٞ
evidence.rationale: Seea bihim wadaqa bihim tharAAan: triple-distress vocabulary. Hatha yawmun AAaseebun: day-characterization as trying.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوۡمُهُۥ يُهۡرَعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ وَمِن قَبۡلُ كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطۡهَرُ لَكُمۡۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ فِي ضَيۡفِيٓۖ أَلَيۡسَ مِنكُمۡ رَجُلٞ رَّشِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Haolai banatee hunna atharu lakum: daughter-offer as purity-alternative. Faittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni fee dayfee: taqwa-shame dual appeal.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Host-guest obligation shown at maximum intensity. Atharu (purer) frames offer as moral upgrade not compromise. Tukhzooni (disgrace me) personalizes communal violation.

candidates.label: City inversion and sijjeel stone rain: high-made-low with marked stones from Lord establishing distinctive punishment signature for Lut's people
candidates.definition: In 11:82-83: When command came We made high low rained stones of layered hard clay marked from your Lord not far from wrongdoers.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا جَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ مَّنضُودٖ
evidence.rationale: JaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha: spatial-inversion as moral-symbolic act. Waamtarna AAalayha hijaratan min sijjeelin mandoodin: material-specificity (layered baked clay).

evidence.excerpt: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَۖ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٖ
evidence.rationale: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika: divine-marking indicating targeted precision. Wama hiya mina alththalimeena bibaAAeedin: proximity-warning to all wrongdoers.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Spatial-inversion embodies moral-inversion symbolism. Sijjeel-mandood specificity distinguishes from generic destruction. BibaAAeedin warning universalizes lesson beyond single community.

candidates.label: Economic justice as prophetic mission: Shu'ayb combines tawheed with measure-weight fairness prohibiting deprivation and earth-corruption linking commerce to faith
candidates.definition: In 11:84-85: Worship Allah no deity other Him. Do not decrease measure scale. Give full measure weight in justice. Do not deprive people things. Do not abuse earth corrupting.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَإِلَىٰ مَدۡيَنَ أَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۖ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيۡرٖ وَإِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٖ مُّحِيطٖ
evidence.rationale: Wala tanqusoo almikyala waalmeezana: economic-command immediately follows tawheed. Innee arakum bikhayrin: prosperity-acknowledgment preventing ascetic reading.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
evidence.rationale: Awfoo almikyala waalmeezana bialqisti: positive-command with justice-standard. Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum: deprivation-prohibition. Wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena: systemic-corruption prohibition.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Only prophet-narrative where economic ethics equals tawheed in prominence. Bialqisti establishes objective standard beyond subjective fairness. Earth-corruption framing elevates commercial dishonesty to ecological-spiritual crime.

candidates.label: Baqiyyat Allah concept: what remains lawful from Allah is best for believers linking honest remainder to faith condition as economic-spiritual principle
candidates.definition: In 11:86: What remains from Allah is best for you if you are believers. I am not guardian over you.

evidence.excerpt: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيۡكُم بِحَفِيظٖ
evidence.rationale: Baqiyyatu Allahi khayrun lakum: divine-remainder superiority claim. In kuntum mumineena: faith-condition. Wama ana AAalaykum bihafeethin: prophetic-non-coercion disclaimer.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Baqiyyah (remainder) implies honest profit after fair dealing vs fraudulent gain. Faith-condition makes economic honesty a belief-test. Non-guardianship disclaimer preserves human agency.

candidates.label: Reform-intent declaration: Shu'ayb states only intending islaha as able with success only through Allah establishing prophetic methodology combining effort with tawakkul
candidates.definition: In 11:88: I only intend reform as much as I am able. My success is only through Allah. Upon Him I rely and to Him I return.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنۡهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أُخَالِفَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنۡهَىٰكُمۡ عَنۡهُۚ إِنۡ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِصۡلَٰحَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُۚ وَمَا تَوۡفِيقِيٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ
evidence.rationale: In oreedu illa alislaha ma istataAAtu: effort-bounded reform intent. Wama tawfeeqee illa biAllahi: success-attribution. AAalayhi tawakkaltu wailayhi oneebu: trust-return pairing.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Ma istataAAtu acknowledges human limitation without excusing inaction. Tawfeeq-success attribution prevents reformer-pride. Tawakkul-Inabah pairing models complete prophetic orientation.

candidates.label: Leadership-to-Fire pattern: Firawn leads people into Fire on Resurrection demonstrating that following non-rashid leadership produces collective damnation
candidates.definition: In 11:97-98: They followed Firawn's command; not rashid. He precedes people on Resurrection leads them into Fire; wretched destination.

evidence.excerpt: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۖ وَمَآ أَمۡرُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِرَشِيدٖ
evidence.rationale: FaittabaAAoo amra firAAawna: active-following verb. Wama amru firAAawna birasheedin: leadership-quality negation.

evidence.excerpt: يَقۡدُمُ قَوۡمَهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَأَوۡرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡوِرۡدُ ٱلۡمَوۡرُودُ
evidence.rationale: Yaqdumu qawmahu yawma alqiyamati: vanguard-position inverted from worldly leadership. Faawradahumu alnnara: fire-leading as leadership-consequence. Wabisa alwirdu almawroodu: wretchedness-emphasis.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Leadership-responsibility principle: leaders bear amplified accountability. Qadama (precedes) inverts worldly precedence into eschatological liability. Birasheedin negation defines minimum leadership qualification.

candidates.label: Self-wronging principle: Allah did not wrong destroyed communities; they wronged themselves; false gods availed nothing establishing divine justice in punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:101: We did not wrong them but they wronged themselves. Their gods invoked besides Allah availed nothing when Lord's command came.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡۖ فَمَآ أَغۡنَتۡ عَنۡهُمۡ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِي يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمۡ غَيۡرَ تَتۡبِيبٖ
evidence.rationale: Wama thalamnahum walakin thalamoo anfusahum: explicit self-wronging attribution. Fama aghnat AAanhum alihatuhum: false-gods futility demonstration. Min shayin lamma jaa amru rabbika: total-uselessness at critical moment.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Self-wronging doctrine absolves divine justice of any unfairness charge. False-gods-futility proven at decisive moment (not abstractly). Pattern applies universally across all destroyed nations.

candidates.label: Shaqiyy-sa'eed duality with conditional eternity: wretched in Fire prosperous in Paradise both abiding while heavens earth endure except what Lord wills preserving divine sovereignty
candidates.definition: In 11:107-108: Wretched in Fire with exhaling inhaling abiding while heavens earth endure except Lord wills; Lord is Effecter of what He intends. Prosperous in Paradise abiding similarly; uninterrupted bestowal.

evidence.excerpt: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
evidence.rationale: Khalideena feeha ma damati alssamawatu waalardu: duration-tied-to-cosmos. Illa ma shaa rabbuka: divine-will exception. Inna rabbaka faAAAAalun lima yureedu: effecter-attribute justifying exception.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُواْ فَفِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَۖ عَطَآءً غَيۡرَ مَجۡذُوذٖ
evidence.rationale: AAataan ghayra majthoothin: uninterrupted-bestowal emphasizing permanence for sa'eed.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Conditional-eternity formula (illa ma shaa rabbuka) preserves absolute divine sovereignty over even eternal states. Cosmos-duration tie makes eternity comprehensible. Ata' ghayr majthoothin assures believers of unbroken divine generosity.

candidates.label: Istiqamah command: remain steadfast as commanded with those who turned with you; do not transgress; He is Seeing establishing perseverance-community-vigilance triad
candidates.definition: In 11:112: Remain steadfast as commanded, you and those who turned with you. Do not transgress. Indeed He is Seeing of what you do.

evidence.excerpt: فَٱسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Faistaqim kama omirta: steadfastness tied to received command. Waman taba maAAaka: communal dimension. Wala tatghaw: transgression-prohibition. Innahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun: divine-surveillance as motivation.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Istiqamah directed specifically to Prophet after historical lessons. Communal inclusion (waman taba) prevents individualistic reading. Baseer attribute makes vigilance internal not external.

candidates.label: Anti-inclination to wrongdoers: do not lean toward oppressors lest Fire touch you; no protectors besides Allah; no help available establishing association-danger principle
candidates.definition: In 11:113: Do not incline toward wrongdoers lest Fire touch you. You have no protectors besides Allah; then you would not be helped.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَرۡكَنُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wala tarkanoo ila allatheena thalamoo: inclination-prohibition (rakanoo implies leaning/trusting). Fatamassakumu alnnaru: fire-contact as consequence. Wama lakum min dooni Allahi min awliyaa: protector-absence. Thumma la tunsaroona: help-impossibility.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Rakanoo (incline/lean) targets subtle sympathy not overt alliance. Fire-contact (tamassakum) suggests even proximity burns. Triple-negative (no protectors, no help) eliminates escape routes.

candidates.label: Hasanat remove sayyi'at: good deeds actively eliminate misdeeds establishing practical spiritual purification mechanism tied to prayer timing
candidates.definition: In 11:114: Establish prayer at two ends of day and night approach. Indeed good deeds remove misdeeds. That is reminder for rememberers.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَيِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡحَسَنَٰتِ يُذۡهِبۡنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلذَّـٰكِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Waaqimi alssalata tarafayi alnnahari wazulafan mina allayli: temporal-specificity for prayer. Inna alhasanati yuthhibna alssayyiati: active-removal mechanism. Thalika thikra lilththakireena: reminder-function for receptive hearts.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Yuthhibna (remove/dispel) stronger than 'forgive' suggesting active cleansing. Prayer-timing specification links ritual regularity to moral maintenance. Dhikra positioning makes this actionable wisdom not abstract theology.

candidates.label: Uloo baqiyyah diagnosis: why no generations with enduring discrimination forbidding corruption? Few saved; wrongdoers pursued luxury were criminals identifying civilizational-collapse mechanism
candidates.definition: In 11:116: Why were there not among generations before those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption except few We saved? Wrongdoers pursued luxury therein and were criminals.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ أُوْلُواْ بَقِيَّةٖ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡفَسَادِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ أَنجَيۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۗ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَآ أُتۡرِفُواْ فِيهِ وَكَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Falawla kana mina alqurooni min qablikum oloo baqiyyatin: counterfactual questioning. Yanhawna AAani alfasadi fee alardi: active-corruption-prevention as criterion. Illa qaleelan mimman anjayna minhum: remnant-salvation exception. WaittabaAAa allatheena thalamoo ma otrifoo feehi: luxury-pursuit as decline-driver. Wakanoo mujrimeena: criminality-conclusion.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Uloo baqiyyah (those with remainder/endurance) identifies moral vanguard as civilization-preservation mechanism. Luxury-pursuit (ma otrifoo) explains elite corruption. Criminality-diagnosis (mujrimeena) reframes cultural decline as moral failure.

candidates.label: Divine justice constraint: Lord would not destroy cities unjustly while people are reformers establishing muslihoona as divine-punishment safeguard
candidates.definition: In 11:117: Your Lord would not destroy cities unjustly while their people are reformers.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wama kana rabbuka liyuhlika alqura bithulmin: injustice-negation. Waahluha muslihoona: reformer-presence as protection-condition.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes divine self-limitation based on human righteousness. Muslihoona (reformers) sets minimum threshold for communal preservation. Bithulmin negation protects divine justice reputation.

candidates.label: Difference as divine will: if Lord willed could make mankind one community but they continue differing; mercy-exception as creation purpose
candidates.definition: In 11:118-119: If Lord willed He could make mankind one community but they differ. Except whom Lord mercied; for that He created them.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخۡتَلِفِينَ
evidence.rationale: Walaw shaa rabbuka lajaAAala alnnasa ommatan wahidatan: hypothetical-unification showing divine capacity. Wala yazaloona mukhtalifeena: persistent-difference as observed reality.

evidence.excerpt: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمۡۗ وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
evidence.rationale: Illa man rahima rabbuka: mercy-exception. Walithalika khalaqahum: creation-purpose identification. Watammat kalimatu rabbika: fulfilled-word as eschatological anchor.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Reframes pluralism from problem to divine design. Mercy-as-creation-purpose gives positive meaning to difference. Hell-filling word balances mercy-theme with accountability.

candidates.label: Closing tawheed-tawakkul synthesis: Allah owns unseen heavens earth; all matter returns to Him; worship and rely on Him; Lord not unaware of deeds
candidates.definition: In 11:123: To Allah belongs unseen of heavens earth. To Him returns all matter. Worship Him and rely on Him. Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.

evidence.excerpt: وَلِلَّهِ غَيۡبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَيۡهِۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Walillahi ghaybu alssamawati waalardi: unseen-ownership. Wailayhi yurjaAAu alamru kulluhu: comprehensive-return. FaoAAbudhu watawakkal AAalayhi: worship-trust pairing as response. Wama rabbuka bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona: divine-awareness as final motivation.

candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Surah-closure mirrors opening themes completing ring structure. Ghayb-ownership affirms limits of human knowledge. Worship-tawakkul pairing summarizes entire prophetic message. Ghafilin-negation provides perpetual accountability motivation.
